# umami_website (Resource)

A website tracked by Umami. The website ID is what the tracker script needs in `data-website-id`. See [documentation](https://docs.umami.is/docs/api/websites) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "umami_team" "client" {
  name = "Example Client"
}

# The id is derived from the domain, so it is known at plan time and can be
# passed to the frontend build (data-website-id) in the same apply.
resource "umami_website" "example" {
  id      = uuidv5("dns", "app.example.com")
  name    = "Example app"
  domain  = "app.example.com"
  team_id = umami_team.client.id

  replay_config = {
    replay_enabled  = true
    heatmap_enabled = true
    sample_rate     = 0.1
    mask_level      = "strict"
    block_selector  = "[data-private]"
  }
}

output "website_id" {
  value = umami_website.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain of the website, without scheme or path, e.g. `example.com`. Umami uses it as a label only and does not restrict where events come from.
- `name` (String) Display name of the website.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the website. Set it to know the ID at plan time, e.g. `uuidv5("dns", "example.com")`. It must be an RFC 4122 UUID, which `random_uuid` does not reliably produce. Generated by Umami when omitted. Changing it forces a new website, which loses its analytics history.
- `replay_config` (Attributes) Session replay and heatmap settings. When omitted, Terraform leaves them to the Umami UI. Removing it after it was set resets them, which turns both off. Recording also needs Umami's recorder script on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replay_config))
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns the website. When omitted, the website belongs to the authenticated user. Changing it transfers the website and keeps its data. Without admin rights, moving a website out of a team requires the team-owner role in that team.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) ID of the user that created the website.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user that owns the website, or null when a team owns it.

<a id="nestedatt--replay_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replay_config`

Optional:

- `block_selector` (String) CSS selector for elements to leave out of replays.
- `heatmap_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to record heatmaps. Defaults to `false`.
- `heatmap_sample_rate` (Number) Share of sessions to record heatmaps for, from 0 to 1. The recorder uses 0.15 when omitted.
- `mask_level` (String) How much page content replays hide: `strict` or `moderate`. The recorder uses `moderate` when omitted.
- `max_duration` (Number) Longest replay to record, in milliseconds. The recorder uses 300000 (5 minutes) when omitted.
- `replay_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to record session replays. Defaults to `false`.
- `sample_rate` (Number) Share of sessions to record replays for, from 0 to 1. The recorder uses 0.15 when omitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Existing websites keep their analytics history when imported by ID.
terraform import umami_website.example a8729a96-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
